scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply padudata --local && wrangler dev
scripts.orders: wrangler d1 execute padudata --remote --command "SELECT created_at, code, plan, billing, amount, payment_method, status, name, company, email, whatsapp, role, npwp_count, invoice_volume, source, utm_source FROM orders WHERE product = 'kreditin' ORDER BY created_at DESC"
